english_text: Are you ready to fight back?
Cease fire! We are attacking our allies!
Freedom doesn’t come without a fight.
I salute you, fallen Iceni queen!
czech_text: Vzdávám ti čest, padlá královno Icenů!

english_text: I will show you the way!
Never underestimate those who fight for right.
czech_text: Nikdy nepodceňuj ty, kdo bojují za pravdu.

english_text: Our allies' countermeasures have caught us!
czech_text: Chytili jsme se do spojeneckých nástrah!

english_text: Our countermeasures have caught our allies!
Our foes have lost their leader!
Our men are ready to rejoin the battle!
czech_text: Naši muži se mohou vrátit do boje!

english_text: Stop! We're firing on allied troops!
Sulla! You were no match for me!
Take the enemy base, or take the enemy out!
czech_text: Dobijte jejich základnu, nebo je všechny pobijte!

english_text: Take the fight to the oppressors!
The battle is lost, but the struggle continues!
czech_text: Bitva je ztracena, ale boj pokračuje!

english_text: The enemy base has fallen to us!
The enemy base will fall to us!
The foe has captured our base!
They have our base! We are defeated!
We are beaten but not bowed!
We have struck the first blow!
We will never be slaves again!
We've been hurt by our allies' countermeasures!
